text: Pleasures are fragile, manifold, and fleeting; it is by them alone that this world of becoming is sustained. For what purpose do the worlds here wander about? They strive to accomplish what is already done. Let the mind be stilled, freed from the hundreds of snares of hope and the torments of desire, and settled in tranquility. If our words are to be believed, then know that desire, by its own power, arises and returns to its own abode.
